question: 一共有多少个客户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers

question: 2024 年有多少笔订单被取消了？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop.orders o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'

question: 2024 年的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
note: 销售额 = 已完成订单的实付金额，要扣折扣

question: 2025 年各渠道的销售额是多少？按从高到低排。
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY sales DESC

question: 2024 年各品类的毛利额，从高到低排。
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost * oi.quantity) AS gp FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gp DESC
note: 毛利 = 实付金额 - products.unit_cost * quantity

question: 2024 年消费金额最高的 5 个客户是谁？各花了多少钱？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS spend FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: 各区域分别有多少个客户？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers GROUP BY region
SELECT region, COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers WHERE region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region
note: region 为空的客户单列或剔除都算对

question: 2025 年各区域的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.region

SELECT c.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND c.region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.region
note: region 为空的单列或剔除都算对

question: 2024 年每个月的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.order_date)
note: 标准答案只留销售额一列（按月排好）：月份的写法太多（2024-01、1、日期），不拿来比

question: 各渠道的退货率是多少？（退货订单数占全部订单数的比例）
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'returned')::numeric / COUNT(*) FROM shop.orders GROUP BY channel

question: 2024 年的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
note: 客单价 = 已完成订单的实付金额 / 已完成订单数

question: 2024 年有多少个客户完成了 15 笔及以上的订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM shop.orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15) t

question: 2025 年华东地区销售额最高的商品是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN shop.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND c.region = '华东' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS sales FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN shop.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND c.region = '华东' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1
note: 种子数据的商品名不唯一（40 个商品只有 8 个名字，每个名字 5 个商品）。按 product_id 分组更严谨，按名字分组也暂且算对；修好种子数据后改成只认 product_id

question: 2030 年的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2030-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2031-01-01'
note: 数据只到 2025-10，应该说没有数据，不能编数字

question: 2024 年政府客户和企业客户各贡献了多少销售额？
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' AND c.segment IN ('政府', '企业') GROUP BY c.segment
note: 顺手把「个人」也列出来不算错

question: 每个品类有几个商品？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM shop.products GROUP BY category

question: 2025 年线上渠道的销售额比线下多多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = '线上') - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = '线下') FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.channel IN ('线上', '线下') GROUP BY o.channel
answer_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = '线上') - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.channel = '线下') FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
note: SQL 直接算出差值，或者查出两个渠道各多少、在回答里减，取数都算对；回答里必须有差值

question: 哪些城市的客户数量超过 16 个？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM shop.customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 16
note: 上海正好 16 个，「超过」不含 16

question: 最好的客户是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.customer_name FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
note: 按消费金额或按下单次数都算对（系统提示词要求先按最常见口径算，再说明）

question: 2025 年第三季度的销售额比第二季度增长了百分之多少？
gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01') - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01')) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01') FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01'
answer_sql: SELECT (SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-10-01') - SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01')) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01') FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
note: SQL 直接算出增长率，或者查出 Q2、Q3 各多少、在回答里算，取数都算对；回答里必须有增长率
